Description: A test module could ignore ctx.target and act outside scope, since modules currently run with the orchestrator's own privileges and scope.py cannot inspect what a module's code actually does
Mitigation: All modules in this repo were authored and reviewed in this session; a future third-party module must be code-reviewed before registration. No automated enforcement exists yet beyond the scope check at the start of execute_module.
Trigger: Adding a new test module from an untrusted source
Escalation condition: Any module bypasses assert_in_scope() and reaches a live network/filesystem call outside the evidence directory

Description: No human owners assigned for any of the roles the Phase 1 delivery model requires (Security lead, QA lead, etc.) - see ownership-map.md
Impact: Medium (reduced from High - risk acknowledged and accepted
Owner: Resolved via DR-0001 (docs/phase1/decisions/0001-single-operator-process.md, 2026-10-09): repository owner explicitly accepted a single-operator process. Every 'X lead approves' criterion is now satisfied by repository-owner review instead of a separate named role. Separation-of-duties assurance remains reduced - this is accepted, not fixed.
Escalation condition: Owner brings in a separate reviewer and this decision is superseded
Status: Repository owner reopens the question or a later DR supersedes DR-0001

Description: Layer 4 (Android) cannot be implemented beyond interface + unbuilt Kotlin source - no device, emulator, or Gradle build is available in any environment used so far
Owner: Documented as unavailable in docs/LIMITATIONS.md and traceability.csv (L4-1). Per the delivery model's own deferral criteria, this qualifies for formal deferral rather than blocking Phase 1 release, since it is infrastructure not necessary to the local simulator's safety/execution contract.
Escalation condition: Attempting to execute any Layer 4 module
Status: Phase 1 is released while Layer 4 is claimed as implemented rather than deferred

Description: docker-compose.yml (Postgres path) has never been run end-to-end - no Docker daemon in this environment
Mitigation: SQLite path is fully tested and used as the default for local dev/tests; Postgres path needs validation in an environment with a working Docker daemon before being relied on for a real deployment.
Trigger: Deploying via docker-compose for the first time
Escalation condition: Postgres path is claimed production-ready without ever having been started

Description: RunStatus enum did not implement the full completion-state vocabulary required by the delivery model (missing skipped/flaky/unavailable/not-run as distinct states - previously folded into 'error' or absent)
Mitigation: Resolved: RunStatus now has pass/fail/blocked/unsupported/skipped/flaky/unavailable/not-run/error (traceability row SAFE-4). Residual: FLAKY and not-run are defined but no code path currently produces them automatically (no flake-detection or run-cancellation logic exists) - tracked as a smaller follow-up, not a release blocker.
Trigger: A module result that is genuinely flaky and nothing marks it as such
Escalation condition: A flaky result is silently reported as pass/fail across repeated runs with no FLAKY status ever applied

Description: No static/dependency security scanning exists anywhere in the repo. npm install for the dashboard reported 2 unreviewed transitive vulnerabilities (1 moderate, 1 high).
Mitigation: Run npm audit and triage the two flagged vulnerabilities; add bandit (Python) and npm audit / a SCA tool to CI once M5 begins. Not yet done.
Trigger: Any dependency update or first CI implementation
Escalation condition: Phase 1 is released with a known, untriaged high-severity dependency finding

Description: No CI exists at all - every test run so far has been manual, in this one session. Nothing prevents a future change from silently breaking the 21 passing tests.
Mitigation: M5 (CI/CD and local automation enforcement) has not been started. This is the single largest structural gap against the delivery model.
Trigger: Any future code change without a human re-running pytest manually
Escalation condition: A regression ships because no CI caught it

Description: Layer 2/3 bundled synthetic placeholder datasets had a provenance note in code comments and docs/LIMITATIONS.md, but no machine-readable dataset/fixture metadata schema (classification, consent status, source) existed, as the delivery model's M1 Task 4 requires.
Mitigation: Resolved: backend/app/schemas/fixture_metadata.py (FixtureMetadataV1) plus fixtures_registry.py now declare and validate all 4 bundled fixtures as SYNTHETIC (traceability row SCHEMA-2). Residual: the schema/registry exist but nothing currently validates a NEW fixture against them automatically before it's used by a layer module - that wiring (e.g. a registry.register_fixture() call layer modules go through) is not built, so a future fixture could still be added without going through FixtureMetadataV1 unless the author remembers to.
Trigger: Adding a new fixture or dataset to any layer without registering it in fixtures_registry.py
Escalation condition: A fixture is used without any recorded classification and the gap isn't caught before release

Description: This M0-M6 governance process was introduced after Phase 1 code already existed; M1-M6 have not been formally executed against it. Treating the existing code as having satisfied M1-M6 would be a false claim.
Mitigation: This risk register and traceability.csv are the first real artifacts of this process. With DR-0001 resolving SCHED-1 and the M1 schema/completion-vocabulary work (SAFE-4, SCHEMA-1/2/3, POLICY-1) now pass/in-progress, M1's substantive criteria are mostly exercised; docs/ROADMAP.md item 1 (a /security-review pass) remains the next concrete step toward formally exiting M1.
Trigger: Any claim that Phase 1 is 'done' under this delivery model
Escalation condition: Phase 1 release is approved under M6 without M1-M5 ever having been run

Description: EvidenceManifestV1 schema exists and is tested, but nothing builds and writes a real manifest.json for an actual release yet - the delivery model's 'Final evidence package' is a schema with no corresponding build step.
Mitigation: Tracked as traceability row SCHEMA-3 (in-progress). Needs a script that: collects commit/tool-versions/config-hash/fixture-ids, hashes the evidence/ directory's contents, pulls test_statuses from the TestRun table, and writes evidence/phase1/<release-id>/manifest.json conforming to the schema. Not built yet.
Trigger: Any attempt to assemble a real Phase 1 evidence package for M6 release review
Escalation condition: M6 release review proceeds without a real manifest.json, only the schema that would validate one

Description: No test in this repo exercised the ERROR path (a module's run() raising an unhandled exception) - runner.py's try/except around module.run() was validated by code inspection only, not a reproduced failure.
Mitigation: Resolved: backend/tests/test_runner_failure_injection.py adds a throwaway, non-registered TestModule with a deliberately raising run() and asserts RunStatus.ERROR plus traceback capture in raw_output.
Trigger: Any future change to runner.py's exception handling
Escalation condition: A regression silently converts a module crash into a false pass/fail instead of ERROR, and nothing catches it
